claims.gist: Platform layer of CNAPP is consolidating while the capability layer unbundles
Suite acquisitions integrated in slide decks first make modules uneven in quality
Specialists keep emerging in runtime, identity, data security and supply chain
Pick a platform for the shared layer, but score it module by module
Keep specialists where gaps affect real risk and feed their findings to the central view
Bundled discounts often sell shelfware, so avoid unused modules
Today's specialist is next year's feature, and sometimes the reverse

thesis: CNAPP consolidates at the shared platform layer but unbundles at the capability layer; buyers should treat them differently.
